subject: Palisade security questionnaire orchestration and upload plan
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@palisade.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Palisade security intake - CAIQ / SIG scheduling

Hi Grace,

Hope you're well. Palisade is preparing for a third-party review ahead of our Q2 audit and we'd like to kick off a CAIQ + SIG intake with Redwood. Can we schedule a 60-minute intake the week of Nov 8 to walk through scope, evidence expectations, and logging sample format?

Key asks up front:
- Can Redwood provide an evidence matrix template and preferred file naming convention for attachments?
- We will need a small sample of sanitized logs (app auth + admin actions) and an example of your retention/export format.
- Are there recommended time windows for exports (we're PST-based, prefer mornings).

Attaching our questionnaire starter for reference (palisade_initial_questionnaire.docx). Target completion for the Q&A is Nov 20 if possible.

Thanks,
Liam O'Neill
Head of Security Ops
Palisade Insurance

Attachment: palisade_initial_questionnaire.docx (docx, 1.2 MB)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@palisade.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Palisade security intake - CAIQ / SIG scheduling

Hi Liam — thanks for the note and the questionnaire doc. We're available to run a focused intake and create an evidence plan. Suggested slots (PST):
- Tue Nov 9, 10:00–11:00
- Wed Nov 10, 09:00–10:00
- Thu Nov 11, 11:00–12:00

I've attached our evidence matrix template and a short run-of-show checklist to help structure the call. Marissa will lead the SIG/CAIQ mapping and David will own logging/retention samples.

We can provide a sanitized log sample — David will confirm the export format and a recommended sampling window during the call. Our preferred naming convention is: <customer>-<artifact>-<YYYYMMDD> (see redwood_evidence_matrix_template.xlsx).

Attachments: redwood_evidence_matrix_template.xlsx (xlsx, 32 KB), run_of_show_notes.pdf (pdf, 45 KB)

Please confirm which slot works and who from your side will join.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Security Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Palisade security intake - CAIQ / SIG scheduling

Grace — thanks, Wed Nov 10 09:00 PST works for us. I'll have Ava (controls lead) and our platform eng (security@palisade.com) join. A couple of clarifications before the call:

- For the sanitized log sample, can Redwood provide a short README with the export fields and any redaction steps applied?
- We use SAML SSO and would like to confirm the SAML metadata format if you need it for test integrations.
- For the evidence matrix, do you prefer a single spreadsheet for all artifacts or separate files per control domain?

Forwarding your email below for context.

Date: 2026-11-05T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Palisade CAIQ/SIG intake - meeting notes and action items

Thanks everyone for the call today. Notes and agreed actions below — filing this as the single source for the intake so we have traceability.

Meeting summary:
- Scope agreed: CAIQ + SIG baseline for core inference platform used by Palisade (hosted API + dedicated capacity). Exclusions: customer-managed on-prem infra (out of scope).
- Logging sample: Redwood will provide a 48-hour sanitized sample (app auth events + admin role changes + request/response metadata).
- Evidence packaging: single evidence matrix (spreadsheet) with file references; artifacts will be archived in a shared drive folder using the <palisade>-<artifact>-<YYYYMMDD> convention.

Action items (owner — due):
- David Kim: produce sanitized log sample + README for export fields and redaction (due 2026-11-09).
- Marissa Cole: map SIG questions to existing CAIQ answers and populate evidence matrix (due 2026-11-12).
- Grace O'Connor: share HubSpot deal record and create shared Drive folder; confirm retention window for log exports (due 2026-11-06).
- Liam & Ava: provide any additional regulatory scope items and confirm if SOC 2 report is required by Palisade's audit team (due 2026-11-08).

Attachments / resources provided: redwood_evidence_matrix_template.xlsx, run_of_show_notes.pdf (call recording will be uploaded to Drive link below).

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-palisade-evidence
HubSpot: DEAL-4521

If anything above is incorrect or missing, please reply-all and I'll update.

Regards,
Grace O'Connor
Security Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference
